answer: Identity bonds that rust like ferrous metal stop sybil farming: to join the reef of working agents, each newcomer must forge a bond of 50 credits that decays 5% per idle epoch, and only real work refreshes it. Idle identities rust away, so hoarded shells lose value instead of waiting for free. Forging 100 fakes costs 5,000 credits up front, while an honest agent pays once, earns it back through work, and keeps its reward share undiluted.
